description: TERMINOLOGY hierarchy (release detail -> codelists table -> codelist detail -> terms table, with optional compatibilities/assets tabs) and TEMPLATES hierarchy (template detail -> template versions table). Reuses the DetailHeader and the flat-param routing pattern established in FEAT-001, and completes the Standards index row wiring for releases and templates. Depends on FEAT-001 (DetailHeader must exist; the products onRowClick pattern is the template to follow).
steps: Create src/routes/_app/standards/releases/$releaseId.tsx. `createFileRoute('/_app/standards/releases/$releaseId')`; `const { releaseId } = Route.useParams()`. Header: `useGetRelease(releaseId)` -> DetailHeader fields Code, Version, Provider, Product, Lifecycle(StatusBadge), Content schema, Publication date(formatDate), Created(formatDate), Applicable modules(join || '—'). PageHeader title = release ? `${release.code} ${release.version}` : 'Terminology release'; ghost Button Link to='/standards' 'Back to standards'. Codelists: `useListCodelists(releaseId)` -> ResourceTable columns code, name, submission_value(cell: row.submission_value ?? '—'), concept_id(cell: row.concept_id ?? '—'), extensible(cell: row.extensible ? 'Yes':'No'); onRowClick -> navigate({to:'/standards/codelists/$codelistId', params:{codelistId: row.id}}); resourceLabel='codelists'. OPTIONAL: wrap codelists + two more tabs (Compatibilities: useListTerminologyCompatibilities(releaseId) columns relationship, standard_version_id, terminology_scope, standard_purpose; Assets: useListTerminologyAssets(releaseId) columns role, media_type, checksum, canonical_href(external <a>)) in a Tabs — drop the optional tabs if they complicate typing; the required path is release->codelists.

Create src/routes/_app/standards/codelists/$codelistId.tsx. `createFileRoute('/_app/standards/codelists/$codelistId')`; `const { codelistId } = Route.useParams()`. Header: `useGetCodelist(codelistId)` -> DetailHeader fields Code, Name, Submission value(?? '—'), Concept id(?? '—'), Preferred term(?? '—'), Extensible(Yes/No), Synonyms(`codelist.synonyms.join(', ') || '—'`). PageHeader title = codelist ? `${codelist.code} — ${codelist.name}` : 'Codelist'. Back: once loaded Link to='/standards/releases/$releaseId' params={{ releaseId: codelist.release_id }} 'Back to release'; fallback Link to '/standards'. Terms: `useListTerms(codelistId)` -> ResourceTable columns code, submission_value, decode(className 'max-w-sm truncate'), concept_id(?? '—'), preferred_term(?? '—'), status(cell StatusBadge); resourceLabel='terms'.

Create src/routes/_app/standards/templates/$templateId.tsx. `createFileRoute('/_app/standards/templates/$templateId')`; `const { templateId } = Route.useParams()`. Header: `useGetTemplate(templateId)` returns CatalogIdentity -> DetailHeader fields Code, Name (only these exist). PageHeader title = template ? `${template.code} — ${template.name}` : 'Template'; ghost Button Link to='/standards' 'Back to standards'. Versions: `useListTemplateVersions(templateId)` -> ResourceTable columns version, lifecycle(StatusBadge), checksum, artifact_types(cell: row.artifact_types.join(', ') || '—'), content_schema_versions(join || '—'), created_at(formatDate); resourceLabel='template versions'. No deeper drill required (template version detail route omitted).

Complete src/routes/_app/standards.tsx wiring: ensure ReleasesTab onRowClick navigates to '/standards/releases/$releaseId' and TemplatesTab onRowClick navigates to '/standards/templates/$templateId' (remove any FEAT-001 TODO placeholders). Products onRowClick (from FEAT-001) stays. Do not change columns or tab labels.
Run the gate from the frontend dir and fix any type/lint errors before marking complete.
